sentences.text:
Shri Alok Kumar Sharma, learned counsel for the petit  Ms. Anita Lodhi, learned counsel for the Respondent N Present petition is file for quashment of FIR bearing crime No.582/2022 under Sections 363, 376,
376(2)(n), 506 of IPC and Sections 5 & 6 of POCSO Act at Police Station Karera District Shivpuri on the ground of compromise.

It is committed on behalf of petitioner that petitioner and prosecutrix have solemnized the marriage and they are living together happily and they are having one kid.
Considering the fact that Sections are not compoundable

Petitioner and respondent no.2 are directed to file a fresh application by their joint signatures along with affidavits bringing settlement on record and with a prayer to quash FIR and further proceedings on the basis of settlement.
Let application be filed within three working days.
Parties are directed to appear before Principal Registrar on 27.5.2024 for verification of compromise.
List the matter on 30.5.2024 along with verification report.

(VINAY SARAF) JUDGE Rohit Karansingh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92212874/
